title: Strict Modes Everywhere - Bringing Order Into Dynamics of Mechanical Systems by a Potential Compatible With the Geodesic Flow
journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, vol. 7, no. 2, pp. 2337-2344, April 2022
summary: Strict nonlinear normal modes provide very regular families of oscillations within conservative mechanical systems. However, a strict normal mode will generally be an isolated curve within the configuration space of the system. In this letter, we design a potential that will densely fill the configuration space with strict normal modes such that each configuration belongs to one mode and each mode passes through a common point, the equilibrium. As the potential can be realized by (nonlinear) elastic elements it can be used to execute a variety of periodic trajectories very efficiently. Most of the required torques will come from the elastic elements in the system and not from the actuators. We also design a controller stabilizing the system to a desired target mode and a controller performing swing-up and compensating dissipated energy. Finally, we showcase the approach for a two DoF manipulator. The experiments show that the approach performed well for the example system.

AI.problem: 在保守机械系统中，严格的非线性正常模态（strict nonlinear normal modes）能提供非常规则的振荡族，但一个严格正常模态通常只是系统构型空间中的一条孤立曲线，无法覆盖整个构型空间。论文试图设计一个势能函数，使得构型空间被严格正常模态密集填充，每个构型属于某一条模态，且所有模态都通过一个公共平衡点，从而让机械系统能够高效地执行多种周期性轨迹。
AI.method: 论文设计一个与测地流相容的势能（potential compatible with the geodesic flow），该势能可由（非线性）弹性元件实现，使得构型空间中每个构型都属于一条严格正常模态，且每条模态都经过同一个平衡点。大部分所需力矩由系统中的弹性元件提供，而非执行器。此外，论文设计了两个控制器：一个用于将系统镇定到期望的目标模态的控制器，另一个用于执行摆起（swing-up）并补偿耗散能量的控制器。最后将该方法应用于一个二自由度机械臂示例系统进行展示。
AI.experiment: 摘要中给出了实验对象为二自由度机械臂，并说明实验表明该方法在示例系统上表现良好，但未给出具体的实验设置、比较基线或量化指标。
